item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

goal.why: The user requests a complete ad with a transformation and an ending.

plan.say: I’ll create a simple blue-and-white demo screen, animate its scattered tasks into an orderly day, and add ClearDay at the end. I’ll keep it silent.

params.extra: Use flux-2-klein; represent tasks with blank cards, checkboxes, and abstract line marks.
params.prompt_or_change: A polished fictional daily-planner interface in calm blue and white, with scattered task cards forming a cluttered to-do list, generous whitespace, and a clear uncluttered area at the top.

steps.why: Create the initial messy demo screen without relying on generated lettering.

params.prompt_or_change: Preserve the interface, palette, and task-card designs; arrange the scattered cards into a clean vertical daily schedule with aligned checkboxes and generous spacing, retaining the clear uncluttered area at the top.

steps.why: Provide a matching organized endpoint for the transformation.

params.extra: Use minimax-h3; first input is the start picture, second is the end picture; no audio.
params.prompt_or_change: Hold the cluttered interface briefly, then smoothly glide the scattered task cards into the organized daily schedule; keep the camera fixed and hold the clean final arrangement for the last two seconds.

steps.why: Transform the messy list into a simple daily plan in one continuous silent shot.
Guarantee the exact app name is legible at the end.
